posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
"Tactics" serves a two-fold purpose.

The first and most obvious purpose is a wink-nod to similar turn based RPGs, the most famous among them being Final Fantasy Tactics and my personal favorite in genre, Tactics Ogre.

The second and least obvious at the moment is that it probably has significant bearing and meaning for the story that this arch/game will be attempting to tell. Hard to make that connection without story elements and background info, but give the man the benefit of the doubt here.
